title: Models
about: Open models. Find one, prove it, and fetch it from whichever source is up. No account, no key.

inventory.note: the hub carries no weight bytes; a file request is a 302 to a source that has them, and the hash you check against comes from the index

catalog.note: the whole catalogue in one fetch; read `objects[<owner>/<name>].model` for one model's own address

list.note: no cursor: this dialect cannot enumerate a catalogue larger than 500. Use the catalog object.

item.returns: one model in the Hugging Face dialect

files.returns: every file with its size and sha256

verify.expected_from: the catalog, the tree listing or the manifest -- never the source that served the bytes
